name: pr_merge_digest_light_20261102
comment: ANCHOR: PR_MERGE_DIGEST_LIGHT_20261102 — the merge digest lists open PRs with cheap fields only and fetches body/statusCheckRollup per candidate PR with a bounded retry and a soft per-PR failure; the ~67-PR GraphQL query that returned 504 from 08:15 can no longer fail the whole run. Hermetic: stubbed gh, no network.

The timeout regression (f6612b12f) is registered here too: a real subprocess.TimeoutExpired in one gh call marks that PR detail_unavailable after a bounded retry, a listing timeout fails visibly, and a 401 is never retried.
